topics.name: Language-model behavioral reliability
topics.summary: Controlled probes, steering interventions, and repeated-task tests reveal that model confidence and compliance can shift with framing, context, or feedback. The studies connect internal reasoning signals with observable answer faithfulness and consistency.

topics.name: LLM evaluation and judge reliability
topics.summary: Evaluation research compares rubric design, panel judging, certificates, and human agreement on open-ended and mathematical tasks. Results show aggregate scores can conceal local errors, unstable dissent, or unverified outputs, motivating traceable evidence and uncertainty labels.

topics.name: Long-horizon and real-world agent benchmarks
topics.summary: Persistent benchmarks for coding, science, commerce, games, and operations assess agents over changing state, budgets, and dependencies. They expose failures in sustained planning, prerequisite preservation, cleanup, and transfer that single-turn scores miss.

topics.name: Agent memory and organizational context
topics.summary: Agent memory systems store traces, multimodal records, skills, and organizational experience, then retrieve or compress them under byte and latency limits. Provenance filters, preference-aware recall, and reversible fidelity controls improve reuse without treating every past item as trustworthy.

topics.name: Reliable tool-using agents
topics.summary: Tool-using agents are strengthened with schema-aware planning, causal inspection, postcondition checks, and lightweight behavior controllers. These safeguards reduce redundant actions and unsafe calls while making recovery more targeted when websites, desktops, or APIs return partial state.

topics.name: LLM post-training and reward optimization
topics.summary: Post-training methods combine verifiable rewards, preference signals, policy composition, and adaptive safety constraints. Across alignment and reinforcement-learning settings, careful signal scheduling improves exploration and task utility, while reward collapse and shrinking policy support remain important failure modes.

topics.name: Fairness-aware AI
topics.summary: Fairness studies jointly examine generated data, allocation outcomes, protected-group balance, and downstream utility. Audit design and multi-objective optimization reveal trade-offs that single parity scores hide, while sampling and reward choices materially affect who benefits.

topics.name: Structured and verifiable language-model problem solving
topics.summary: Executable dialogue, hardware-description code, proofs, optimization models, and spatial plans use structured intermediate forms plus compilation, exact checking, or interaction feedback. Making invalid states visible improves search efficiency and reduces semantically plausible but unusable outputs.

topics.name: Efficient language-model inference
topics.summary: Serving systems reduce language-model cost with adaptive exits, cache reuse, tokenization shortcuts, parallel blocks, quantization, and phase-specific recurrent or diffusion decoding. Benchmarks target memory, latency, and throughput while preserving quality on repeated or long prompts.

topics.name: Efficient foundation-model adaptation
topics.summary: Federated adapters, private local personalization, compressed teachers, and robot-model tuning support customization when data, hardware, or model access is restricted. Low-rank updates and selective knowledge transfer limit interference while retaining task-specific performance.

topics.name: Multimodal model safety and robustness
topics.summary: Safety methods for language and vision-language models identify influential neurons or heads, detect image-text conflict, and test transfer under adversarial perturbations. Targeted interventions reduce harmful or hallucinated behavior with smaller utility costs than broad retraining.

topics.name: Language-model interpretability and expert specialization
topics.summary: Black-box inversion, causal context tests, and mixture-of-experts routing analyses examine what internal components reveal or control. Expert activation and response contrasts provide useful evidence of specialization, yet observed behavior still depends strongly on prompt context.

topics.name: Explainable AI and faithfulness
topics.summary: Explanation methods for images, time series, and forensic decisions are assessed with human ratings, causal perturbations, and task-aligned localization. Plausible heat maps or concepts are judged insufficient when they fail to track the computation producing the prediction.

topics.name: Uncertainty calibration
topics.summary: Calibration frameworks estimate reliability at detector coordinates, conformal regions, counterfactual decisions, and metacognitive judgments. Local uncertainty and abstention expose ambiguity more effectively than a single confidence score, especially when models or hypotheses compete.

topics.name: Privacy-preserving and privacy-auditing machine learning
topics.summary: Privacy work spans feature-level disclosure accounting, encrypted retrieval, differentially private generation, and black-box leakage audits. The results quantify how protection changes usefulness and show why document- or sample-level exposure can escape aggregate privacy metrics.

topics.name: Grounded vision-language reasoning
topics.summary: Vision-language systems use textual cues, spatial intermediates, open-vocabulary localization, and cooperative video evidence to ground decisions. Training with verified states or depth transfer improves spatial reasoning, while social tasks reveal residual agreement bias and weak evidence use.

topics.name: Visual domain adaptation
topics.summary: Source-free and few-shot adaptation aligns prototypes, neighborhoods, pseudo-labels, and entity primitives across remote-sensing, wireless, and general visual shifts. Transductive evidence improves recognition or segmentation when target annotations are sparse or absent.

topics.name: Synthetic media forensics
topics.summary: Synthetic-image, video, text, and medical-forgery detectors combine temporal, frequency, bit-plane, and language-style traces. Cross-generator and edited-human tests show that artifact-based cues transfer better than assumptions tied to one creation pipeline.

topics.name: Visual generation, diffusion, and scene editing
topics.summary: Generative systems for images, biology, motion, satellite scenes, and 4D content use retrieval feedback, flow or diffusion transport, selective masks, and trajectory controls. Structured conditioning improves fidelity, temporal consistency, and edits when observations or compute are limited.

topics.name: 3D vision and point-cloud learning
topics.summary: Point-cloud encoders, spiking networks, active view policies, and Gaussian human representations address recognition or reconstruction from sparse 3D observations. Self-supervision and task-aware geometry improve efficiency, novel-view coverage, and editability.

topics.name: Image restoration and enhancement
topics.summary: Restoration models separate structure from detail or add auxiliary priors for compression, low light, underwater imagery, and very large images. Evaluation emphasizes texture fidelity, perceptual quality, and whether recovered detail helps downstream recognition.

topics.name: Medical image segmentation
topics.summary: Medical segmentation methods cover volumetric occupancy, rare classes, weak labels, anatomy, affordances, and synthetic ultrasound or OCT pairs. Expert routing, semantic reports, lightweight decoders, and imperfect-mask training make dense prediction more usable with limited annotation.

topics.name: Clinical CT and MRI analysis
topics.summary: CT and MRI pipelines combine 2D or 3D features, phase alignment, contrast synthesis, anatomical prompts, and workflow automation. Studies assess diagnosis, tumor or vessel delineation, sizing, and robustness to missing or shifted acquisitions.

topics.name: Medical vision-language models
topics.summary: Clinical vision-language models organize patient, organ, disease, and report concepts rather than relying on one global embedding. CT and radiograph studies test retrieval, generation, zero-shot recognition, compression, and endoscopic diagnosis, with fine-grained decisions still needing oversight.

topics.name: Multimodal clinical prediction
topics.summary: Multimodal clinical predictors fuse EEG, gaze, audio, connectivity graphs, competing-risk outcomes, and treatment histories. Domain-aware selection and Bayesian uncertainty improve screening or individualized policy evaluation, but calibration and subgroup checks remain central.

topics.name: Conditional computation for vision
topics.summary: Conditional visual backbones route adapters or implicit-representation weights to specialized experts. Sparse computation reduces interference across heterogeneous tasks and offers signals about which parameter groups carry class information.

topics.name: Document understanding and evidence grounding
topics.summary: Document systems link claims, pages, figures, tables, and annotations, using OCR, region selection, and provenance-aware extraction. Long-record evaluations show better evidence coverage and answer quality when retrieval cost and unresolved cases remain visible.

topics.name: Document retrieval and retrieval-augmented inference
topics.summary: Retrieval-augmented inference uses hypothetical queries, soft evidence alternatives, shape-aware history, sparse-dense fusion, and hierarchical lexical search. These designs improve contextual matching or forecasting while controlling memory, latency, and ranking cost at scale.

topics.name: Recommendation systems
topics.summary: Recommenders model behavior, serving exposure, geography, multimodal item semantics, and conversion feedback. Sequence encoders, prototypes, reinforcement learning, and bandit experiment routing improve ranking quality while connecting offline gains to delivery outcomes.

topics.name: Graph representation learning and domain generalization
topics.summary: Graph models transfer propagation patterns, separate local and global interactions, and transport class evidence across neighborhood resolutions. Tests on domain shifts and noisy power-system measurements favor representations that preserve topology rather than only feature statistics.

topics.name: Relational and tabular foundation models
topics.summary: Synthetic relational tasks vary schema exposure, table structure, and problem complexity to train in-context learners efficiently. Curriculum ordering and generator diversity can reduce database requirements while retaining transfer across relational tasks.

topics.name: Structured dynamical systems learning
topics.summary: Geometric latent mechanics, parameter extrapolation, and Koopman-assisted sparse regression learn dynamical systems with explicit evolution structure. The studies show that denoising and invariant constraints improve equation recovery and long-horizon behavior, including difficult regimes.

topics.name: Physics-informed scientific machine learning
topics.summary: Differentiable surrogates for fractional processes, batteries, PDEs, molecular forces, and ultrasound incorporate equations or known propagators. Physical constraints improve extrapolation and plausibility while retaining data-driven flexibility.

topics.name: Scientific artifact generation and verification
topics.summary: Scientific code, molecules, and equations are generated with domain-aware search, executable simulation, chemical validity checks, and analytical feedback. Verification and complexity control help balance fit, generalization, and artifact usability.

topics.name: Speech and audiovisual modeling
topics.summary: Audio-visual alignment, confidence-aware decoding, turn-taking, and compact flow-based codecs address recognition, dialogue, expressive captioning, and long-form speech generation. Experiments emphasize timing, interruption behavior, drift resistance, and quality across languages or operating conditions.

topics.name: Grounded language understanding of human motion
topics.summary: Wearable activity reasoning and sign-language translation connect language outputs to salient body, hand, face, and temporal evidence. Attribution traces, region supervision, and keyframe selection improve recognition while making sensor use more inspectable.

topics.name: Machine translation
topics.summary: Translation systems reduce deliberation cost or study transfer among related low-resource languages. Difficulty-aware computation and analyses of scripts, family distance, and target conditions explain when efficiency or cross-lingual sharing preserves quality.

topics.name: Cybersecurity automation and threat analysis
topics.summary: Edge classifiers and symbolic attack planners support real-time cyber defense. Lightweight temporal models detect operational anomalies, while predicate-level distinctions make generated response plans easier to validate and explain.

topics.name: Industrial anomaly detection and synthetic inspection data
topics.summary: Streaming log models and object-aware diffusion augmentation target rare failures in infrastructure and industrial imagery. Sequence analysis improves event detection, and synthetic defects with masks strengthen localization when real examples are scarce.

topics.name: Causal inference and adaptive experimentation
topics.summary: Adaptive longitudinal experiments and targeted estimators are compared with analytical and bootstrap uncertainty procedures. The findings show that allocation rules and nuisance-learner choices can change effect precision and interval coverage.

topics.name: Bayesian optimization
topics.summary: Finite-budget studies compare surrogate accuracy, runtime, memory, and regret in scientific and engineering optimization. Expected-improvement analysis links practical model selection with guarantees under smooth-function assumptions.

topics.name: Bandit and sequential decision learning
topics.summary: Value-based control, regularized greedy bandits, hierarchical policies, and intrinsic exploration address sparse feedback and finite interaction horizons. Eligibility handling, parallel skill learning, and tail-robust schedules improve experience efficiency without requiring ideal reward knowledge.

topics.name: Neural memory theory
topics.summary: Theoretical analyses quantify storage, expressivity, and interference in transcript machines and associative neural networks. High-entropy representations and layered memories clarify how capacity can coexist with generalization and resistance to later updates.

topics.name: Quantum circuit optimization
topics.summary: Learned predictors choose quantum simulation strategies and transpiler passes from workload or circuit features. Data-driven autotuning reduces memory or runtime and can lower two-qubit gate counts relative to fixed compiler settings.

topics.name: Combinatorial optimization for routing
topics.summary: Geometric self-supervision and reward shaping improve neural solvers for routing beyond their training scale. Both methods focus on representation invariance and sampling efficiency, with gains evaluated under extrapolation or best-of-K budgets.

topics.name: Vision-language-action robot control
topics.summary: Vision-language-action policies combine temporal histories, predicted world state, viewpoint cues, and runtime consistency checks for manipulation and navigation. Feedback refresh, reflective supervision, and action-conditioned representations reduce drift under disturbances and scene changes.

topics.name: Robot teleoperation and tactile sensing
topics.summary: Event cameras, inertial sensors, and wearable tactile arrays transfer human motion or fingertip contact into robot commands. Low-latency fusion reconstructs geometry and supports replay, teleoperation, and closed-loop grasping in difficult visibility conditions.

topics.name: Contact-rich and deformable robot manipulation
topics.summary: Impedance retargeting, temporally routed action chunks, deformable-object coordination, and transparent-object grasping address contact-sensitive manipulation. Physical trials emphasize force moderation, phase transitions, alignment, load stability, and successful transport.

topics.name: Whole-body and compliant robot control
topics.summary: Whole-body policies and distributed elastic-contact models coordinate mobile manipulation, grasp-then-walk skills, door traversal, and compliant sphere interaction. Coupled dynamics produce feasible motion and more stable contact than independent point actions.

topics.name: Action-conditioned world models for robotics
topics.summary: Flow-matching predictors and stateful visual simulators forecast action consequences for rollout augmentation, risk analysis, and policy ranking. Asynchronous observation injection and learned state keep imagined trajectories closer to physical behavior.

topics.name: Robot planning under geometric and safety constraints
topics.summary: Drone and manipulator planners combine local safe regions, predictive filters, affordance scores, and language guidance. Explicit geometry and task semantics improve feasible route selection and grasp choice in cluttered scenes.

topics.name: Learned robot dynamics and control
topics.summary: Learned robot controllers use temporal multimodal state, transport-based action generation, and barrier constraints for underwater or changing-sensor settings. History initialization lowers generation cost while safety shaping limits risky actions at inference.

topics.name: Robot deployment and real-time perception
topics.summary: Shared policy serving, adaptive perception, and actuator-local learning address real-time robotics under changing compute, sensing, and cable-robot layouts. Scheduling and hardware-aware routing preserve responsiveness while supporting transfer across platforms.

topics.name: Compositional robot imitation learning
topics.summary: Compositional imitation studies combine theory of on-policy expert queries with empirical analysis of instruction and context coverage. Value-aware interaction and dependency-rich demonstrations improve recombination of manipulation skills.

topics.name: Autonomous driving planning and testing
topics.summary: Closed-loop driving methods use latent trajectory steering and interactive world-model tests with explicit validity accounting. The emphasis is on efficient control and distinguishing realized safety evidence from merely generated failure cases.

topics.name: Multi-agent coordination and collaboration
topics.summary: Agent-based simulations and adaptive collaboration workflows study consensus, common ground, repair, and partner selection under asymmetric information. Delayed feedback, incentives, and bottleneck-aware handoffs determine whether cooperation converges or fragments.

topics.name: Agent orchestration and self-improvement
topics.summary: Executable routing policies and population-based harnesses choose decompositions, tools, verification steps, or repaired variants using observed failures. Validation and cost-aware selection can transfer improvements across tasks, though gains remain uneven.

topics.name: Forensic language analysis
topics.summary: Authorship and deception studies compare transformer models, large language models, and character- or token-level statistics across legal and spoken-language data. Domain mismatch and limited samples make compact lexical cues competitive with larger contextual systems.

topics.name: AI-assisted software engineering
topics.summary: Security repair and review of agent-generated code improve when models receive runtime behavior, data flow, repository history, and inferred intent alongside changed lines. These signals help prioritize correctness, security, and performance risks.

topics.name: AI governance and knowledge representation
topics.summary: Entity resolution and ontology engineering turn fragmented disclosures and cybersecurity operations into machine-readable structures. Linking records, relations, and contextual metrics exposes reporting gaps and supports more useful accountability analysis.
